Welcome to Linear

 
Linear is where your team plans and builds products together. Here are a few ways to get up to speed.

Intro to Linear → [https://youtube.com/watch?v=9Q5BoiIFBiY&list=PLP9v0Y4zla9vG7k8e279bSz5hUl0oXlMH&index=1]
A short video walkthrough of the layout and core workflows.
 
Setup guides → [https://linear.app/docs/start-guide#choose-the-onboarding-guide-that-fits-your-role?utm_source=onboarding_flow]
Onboarding guides tailored to your team size.

Live onboarding → [https://luma.com/linear?utm_source=onboarding_flow]
Live sessions where you can see workflows in action and ask questions.

If you need anything, reply to this email or reach out at hello@linear.app. You can also join our Slack community
[https://linear.app/join-slack] or find us on X [https://x.com/linear].
